scope: Premium biological motif plates for SpaceBio-Bench slide/deck visuals.
design_rule: Use as Z2/Z3 biological texture or signpost; do not substitute for measured source evidence.

records.label: Cell state microfield
records.semantic_use: single-cell state, cell composition, sample biology
records.license: Original project artwork; repository MIT license.
records.caution: Use as cellular context, not a specific cell type.

records.label: Mitochondrial stress field
records.semantic_use: organelle stress, metabolism, radiation or oxidative context
records.license: Original project artwork; repository MIT license.
records.caution: Use as biological interpretation only unless mitochondria are measured.

records.label: Organoid spheroid field
records.license: Original project artwork; repository MIT license.
records.caution: Pair with draft/diagnostic caveats for organoid tracks.

records.label: Single-cell droplet field
records.semantic_use: single-cell assay, cell barcode, droplet capture
records.license: Original project artwork; repository MIT license.
records.caution: Do not imply runnable scRNA-seq payload readiness.

records.label: Tissue contour section
records.semantic_use: bulk tissue, histology-like context, tissue-specific result
records.license: Original project artwork; repository MIT license.
records.caution: Symbolic tissue surface, not microscopy proof.

records.label: Epithelial barrier field
records.license: Original project artwork; repository MIT license.

records.label: Vascular microsection
records.license: Original project artwork; repository MIT license.

records.label: Spatial spot tissue field
records.semantic_use: spatial transcriptomics, tissue spots, location-aware biology
records.license: Original project artwork; repository MIT license.

records.label: RNA expression trace

records.label: DNA context trace
